IS 13282 : 2024 Mine Haulage Tracks - Track Sleepers - General Requirements
ICS 73.100.40
ICS 73.100.40
MED 08
MED 08
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard covers the general requirements for track sleepers for use in underground mine transport systems for laying out haulage tracks.
1.2 This standard shall apply to sleepers of lengths between 1 000 mm and 2 000 mm.
1.3 The track sleepers covered by this standard shall be used for underground tub transport or mine car transport rail lines.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contains provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
